column15: To me they were unnoticeable The one friction point I did hit was being asked to complete DID issuance immediately during enrollment — it interrupted the sign-up before I'd even finished registering.
column16: There is a bit of a microsecond delay . It would help if DID issuance wasn't required up front — maybe save my preference and prompt me to finish it later instead of blocking enrollment.

column14: Once unlocked, the private docs content itself was well organized and useful.
column15: The wallet-connect prompt on the private pages wasn't clear that it was the way to unlock the content — I clicked around the page before realizing I had to connect my wallet.
column16: Make the unlock/connect-wallet call to action more explicit, maybe with a short explainer and a link to a tutorial.

column31: Explorar una alianza con una wallet Cardano no custodial, para poder crear la wallet como parte del mismo proceso de inscripción (creación de perfil).
